flashcard_questions.q: A series of exercises performed before physical activity to prepare the body, improve performance and reduce injury risk.
Light cardiovascular activity such as jogging or cycling that gradually increases heart rate at the start of a warm up.
Exercises that move joints through their full range of motion, such as arm swings, ankle rolls and hip circles.

flashcard_questions.a: The ability of ligaments and tendons to stretch and flex without tearing.
A stretch held in a fixed position for 15 to 30 seconds to lengthen a specific muscle.
